confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are estimated from 2026 Zadar-specific guide pages and crowd-sourced cost-of-living sources, which disagree by roughly 30 percent, so they are bounded midpoints. Cocktail and wine are weaker: they rest on guide ranges for Zadar bars, not Numbeo-style city averages. Euro figures were converted to USD at an assumed, unverified rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on live listings or any accommodation search. The FX observation was taken from the RBA Exchange Rates Overview summary in search results; I did not open the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Zadar-specific price ranges from travel and cost-of-living guides, cross-checked against the Croatian coastal price level. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer where direct guide data was thin. Accommodation anchors draw on general knowledge of mid-sized Dalmatian coastal cities in July.
